sentences.text: Login/API unreliable since 17:51 UTC [C-001].
Firestore/Firebase Auth return 503s [C-006].
Google Cloud confirms multi-product issues; Cloudflare confirms failures in Access, our staff-access service [C-005] [C-011] [C-010].
Downdetector reportedly peaked at 14,695 Google Cloud reports [C-016].
Cause, recovery time, full Northwind scope and data impact remain unknown [C-003] [C-004] [C-019] [C-020].
Deploys frozen; escalating to Google; staff using break-glass access; preparing request replay [R-7] [R-8] [R-11] [R-14].
Approval pending: name Google publicly and adopt 30-minute customer updates [R-12] [R-13].
We'll update bridge and customers at 19:20 [R-15].
Google Cloud confirms multi-product issues; Northwind's Firestore and Firebase Auth calls return 503s [C-005][C-006].
Cloudflare confirms Access authentication failures; staff use Access for internal tools [C-011][C-010].
Northwind has only us-central1; engineers cannot load the GCP console [C-009][C-008].
Root cause, recovery time, Cloud Run and staff-tool impact, and data loss, corruption or exposure are not yet known [C-003][C-004][C-019][C-020].
We are checking quota/IAM, escalating by phone/account team, using staff break-glass access, and preparing request replay [R-5][R-8][R-11][R-14].
Deploys remain frozen; no rollback until a change is implicated [R-7][R-3].
Claims Google caused Cloudflare's outage are unverified and should not be acted on [C-018].
We will update bridge and customers at 19:20 [R-15].
We’re sorry customers have been unable to reliably log in or use our API since 17:51 UTC [C-001].
Our cloud provider has confirmed an incident [C-005].
The root cause and recovery time are not yet known [C-003] [C-004].
We’re investigating [R-3].
We’ll provide the next update at 19:20 UTC [R-15].
